title: OSCAR — Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router
summary: OSCAR is a proof-of-concept framework for a shared council digital front door. Its own accessibility and integration benefits remain prospective.
account: Peterborough’s OSCAR is a proof-of-concept framework intended to connect service assistants through one governed digital front door. Public-facing deployment is planned. Accessibility and integration benefits remain prospective.
purpose: Connect service-specific assistants through a shared, governed digital front door.
system: OSCAR, the Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router, and planned OSCAR Workforce
developer: Peterborough City Council (locally designed framework; other developers not specified)

ratings.reason: Reduced duplication and integration costs are intended, with no reported OSCAR-specific result.
A simpler journey between council services is intended. Benefits from public-facing OSCAR deployment are unreported.

ai_role.statement: OSCAR is designed to route requests among specialist agents and apply common governance. It remains a proof of concept, with operational benefits unverified.

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: OSCAR — Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router

produced_by: The framework is designed for web, WhatsApp, and voice channels and for connection to existing services.
The reported design includes centralized permissions, redaction, guardrails, and audit logging.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: Peterborough develops OSCAR to connect council AI services
claim_basis: Sources: the deployer's report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
